subject: Prepladder Tests
title: FMGE Mini Test Series · FMGE Mini Test Series Year 2024 · Mini Test 7 (Surgical Procedures)

questions.stem: A 62-year-old woman was admitted with a retrosternal goiter, which had been discovered during an evaluation for chest discomfort and dyspnea. After routine investigations, including fine needle aspiration cytology (FNAC) and imaging, the surgical team determined she is at high risk of requiring conversion from a transcervical approach to a median sternotomy. Which of the following conditions would not justify the need for a median sternotomy in this patient?
questions.stemHtml: A 62-year-old woman was admitted with a retrosternal goiter, which had been discovered during an evaluation for chest discomfort and dyspnea. After routine investigations, including fine needle aspiration cytology (FNAC) and imaging, the surgical team determined she is at high risk of requiring conversion from a transcervical approach to a median sternotomy. Which of the following conditions would not justify the need for a median sternotomy in this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Goiter extending into the posterior mediastinum

options.label: C
options.text: Diameter of goiter > Diameter of thoracic inlet

options.label: D
options.text: Goiter extending up to the superior margin of the aortic arch
